Top News
 
 
 
 Jobs report, chip earnings and Tesla's Cybercab 
 
 
 
Getty Images
 
 
 Wall Street heads into September with the August jobs report taking center stage, while another round of AI-related earnings and Tesla's Cybercab launch could also move markets.

 Friday's employment report is expected to show the U.S. added 58K jobs in August, with the unemployment rate holding at 4.1% and average hourly earnings rising 0.3%. The numbers will provide investors with a fresh read on the labor market and could influence expectations for the Federal Reserve's next move.

 AI spending will remain in focus during a busy week for tech earnings. Dell Technologies ( DELL ) reports Tuesday, with investors watching AI server demand, while Broadcom ( AVGO ), Snowflake ( SNOW ) and Hewlett Packard Enterprise ( HPE ) follow Wednesday. Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ), MongoDB ( MDB ), Zscaler ( ZS ) and Ciena ( CIEN ) are also scheduled to report.

 Tesla ( TSLA ) will hold an invite-only Cybercab launch event Thursday in Austin, with reports indicating riders could begin requesting the purpose-built autonomous vehicle through Tesla's existing Robotaxi app.

 Elsewhere, John Ternus takes over as Apple ( AAPL ) CEO from Tim Cook on Tuesday, while the Fed releases its Beige Book on Wednesday.

 Earnings spotlight: Wednesday, Sept. 2: Broadcom ( AVGO ), Snowflake ( SNOW ). See the full earnings calendar .

 Earnings spotlight: Thursday, Sept. 3: Ciena ( CIEN ), Zscaler ( ZS ). See the full earnings calendar .

The service will combine deep fundamental research with actionable investment ideas across areas such as AI, semiconductors, networking, memory, and other transformative technologies.

The strategy centers on building a concentrated portfolio of high-conviction opportunities, supported by real-time trade alerts, stock-specific research, industry deep dives, earnings analysis, macro updates, and an active investor community. Jeremy also brings a background in finance, computer science, and fintech, along with a track record of identifying major technology trends early.
